items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: That's the Camellia band... And who's on trumpet? That's Talbridge.

ctx.x: That's the Camellia. That's the Camellia band. And who's this on drums? That's myself, George Henderson. Alright, George Henderson. And who's on trumpet? That's Talbridge. Cuckoo? Yeah, Cuckoo. And Sax? That's George Stewart. And Banjo? Clarence Tisdale. And Bass? Johnny Prudon. And Tramble? And Albert Warning. Alright guys.
The street doesn't have another size of the rehearsal. Lower than that off the rehearsal. Oh yeah, you can't test even on rehearsal.
